name: an-export-relays-out-an-approved-reel-without-asking
find:
if reelDecision == nil, let question = ReelRelayoutNotice.question(for: ev) {
            tracker.begin(Run(phase: .awaitingReelDecision(question,
                                                            destination: destinationRoot,
                                                            onlyDay: onlyDay),
                              isFullExport: onlyDay == nil), for: eventID)
            tracker.deactivate(eventID)
            return
        }
breaks: the export goes back to re-rendering a reel that cannot be reproduced, so the video Dan reviewed and posted is replaced by a different arrangement with nothing said. Measured 2026-09-11, 18 of 21 events are in that state, and the only signal was the finished video looking wrong afterwards (#1407)
